mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 6.0% (UNRATE) signals recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods where UNRATE > 6.0% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 260.0 and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 0.5%, aggressive monetary tightening causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods meeting condition (CPIAUCSL>260.0 AND FEDFUNDS<0.5%) are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market (HOUST > 1600.0) and high residential fixed investment (RSAFS > 500000.0) indicate late-cycle expansion, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in periods meeting condition (HOUST>1600.0 AND RSAFS>500000.0) are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL index above 265.0 signals accelerating inflation, increasing risk of aggressive monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in periods where CPIAUCSL > 265.0 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher employment level (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods where PAYEMS > 50th percentile are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 105.0 and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 0.5%, strong growth with accommodative policy leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in periods meeting condition (INDPRO>105.0 AND FEDFUNDS<0.5%) are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 indicates strong economic activity, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in periods where INDPRO > 105.0 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window < 0.03.
